entries.6d56ae7f5b7a2087: The company is a pure holding company that manages and plans the operations of subsidiaries engaged in the manufacture and sale of metal processed products. At the core of the group, MIE Techno Co., Ltd. is a specialist manufacturer of stainless steel pipe fittings, producing and selling industrial fittings, building fittings, flanges, screwed fittings and prefabricated products, and Chubu Materials Co., Ltd. sells pipe fitting products. The group has a single segment, the Fittings Business, and its revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥7,139 million.
